discussed earlier, for each of these debt issues, I include return-earnings observations from five years prior to and five years after the issue when I apply
the Basu [1997] methodology. This procedure results in 32,716 firm-year
observations. Additional data requirements, such as the presence of nonmissing control variables or the use of Dealscan, further reduce the sample.
